messages.subject: 'ExplainedVariance' function in package "INLAOutputs"
parts:
Dear all,

I recently tried 'ExplainedVariance' function from package "INLAOutputs" to calculate variance explained by each random effect in this model:

formula.c20so.BE581_1=N ~ f(as.numeric(idarea), model = "bym", graph = g20) + 
  f(as.numeric(periode),model="rw1") + f(as.numeric(periode2),model="iid") + 
 f(as.numeric(idarea2),model="besag",graph=g20,group=as.numeric(periode3),control.group = list(model="rw1"))
res.c20so.BE581_1<- inla(formula.c20so.BE581_1,family = "poisson", 
                         data = c20totso2, E=pop, 
                         control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
                         control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE,link=1))

The model run okay, but when I run ExplainedVariance(res.c20so.BE581_1) I get this error message : Error in hyper_sample[, j] : subscript out of bounds.
I tried to use scale.model=TRUE but I still get the same error message.

Does anyone have any idea what happened here? Do I have other option in INLA to calculate variance explained by each random effect in this model?

Kind regards,
Yessika

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] 'ExplainedVariance' function in package "INLAOutputs"

I have no idea. I guess you would like to contact the author(s) of the
INLAOutputs package. I see there is no commits there for the last
(almost) 2 years, https://github.com/oswaldosantos/INLAOutputs

so I do not know how much alive the package is.

Best
H
